# SchoolStack

> SchoolStack puts recruitment, enrollment and accounting in one place for schools of 20 to 250 students, on QuickBooks Online. Three tools are complimentary for every school today, funded by philanthropy: Space, Budget and Access. Design partner schools use the full platform today, and it opens to more schools in 2027.

SchoolStack is a nonprofit venture incubated by Building Hope Impact Fund. It is built around the questions small school founders ask most: Will we make payroll in June? Who still owes us tuition? Will we fill our seats? What do I show my board, my lender or my investors?

QuickBooks Online stays the accounting system of record. SchoolStack does not run payroll and does not replace QuickBooks or Gusto. Pricing for the 2027 platform has not been finalized.

## Tools

- [SchoolStack Space](https://space.schoolstack.ai/): community intelligence and facilities. Who lives near a school, nearby schools and local organizations, plus guides to planning, leasing and buying school space.
- [SchoolStack Budget](https://budget.schoolstack.ai/): an annual budget or a five-year financial plan, built step by step, with reports for a board or lender.
- [SchoolStack Access](https://access.schoolstack.ai/): funding and policy guidance, such as the education freedom tax credit.

Space, Budget and Access are open to any school. Estimates are for planning only and are not loan eligibility.

## Resources

- [Enrollment Audit](https://schoolstack.ai/enrollment/): a self-audit of how a school gets found, chosen, joined and kept, with a plan. Answers stay in the visitor's browser.
- [Year-end giving guide](https://schoolstack.ai/giving): a plan for a nonprofit school's year-end appeal, with email templates and AI prompts.
- [FAQ](https://schoolstack.ai/#faq): what schools can use today, who SchoolStack is for, cost, QuickBooks Online and 2027.
- [About SchoolStack](https://schoolstack.ai/about): the people and values behind SchoolStack.

- [Sign up for early access](https://schoolstack.ai/#early-access): schools can sign up for early access to the full platform and for product updates.
